name: smart-transit-baku
description: Smart Transit — Bakı avtobuslarında real-vaxt sıxlıq (Express API + React SPA)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client-react
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client-react"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix server && npm run lint --prefix client-react
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix client-react
